answer: On an anchor, each identity locks a 75 bond and faces cross-examination. Three examiners, picked by the anchor lattice, no shared source, no repeat trio, each ask a plume question on its prior work. The transcript goes to a forge checkpoint for auditor replay against the plume set; a contradicting or reused transcript burns the 75 bond and each examiner's 40 stake. Fees rise per source: first 20, k-th 20+12(k-1), 1,000th 12,008; 1,000 fakes pay 6,014,000 plus 75,000 at risk. An honest identity pays 20, bond returned. A rented-examiner ring fails at forge replay, losing bonds and stakes.
